workbook.name: TerrestraX_Tracker.xlsx
workbook.intent: One cohesive workbook with a sequenced software build-up and manual fill sheets for mechanical, electronics, and manufacturing streams

software_sequence.title: Refresh architecture baseline
software_sequence.objective: Keep architecture.md and ArchEx outputs current so code structure and next steps stay grounded in reality
software_sequence.entry_criteria: The repo builds enough for ArchEx to analyze it
software_sequence.done_criteria: architecture.md, .archex/metrics.json, and .archex/graph.json reflect the current codebase
software_sequence.validation: ArchEx regenerate completes and outputs are reviewed

software_sequence.title: Validate single-leg kinematics and IK
software_sequence.objective: Prove one leg can reach commanded targets repeatably before broadening to full-body behavior
software_sequence.entry_criteria: Nominal geometry and a single-leg controller scenario are available
software_sequence.done_criteria: Single-leg controller hits targets within agreed tolerance in simulation
software_sequence.validation: Simulation run with target error acceptance bounds

software_sequence.title: Implement raise-to-nominal posture
software_sequence.objective: Move safely from motor zero to the working posture you want to operate from
software_sequence.entry_criteria: Motor-zero and nominal posture definitions both exist
software_sequence.done_criteria: Controller state machine can transition from q=[0,0,0] to nominal without unsafe transient motion
software_sequence.validation: Simulation scenario confirms bounded transition to nominal

software_sequence.title: Separate trajectory paths from time laws
software_sequence.objective: Make locomotion composable by cleanly separating spatial paths from temporal scheduling
software_sequence.entry_criteria: Current locomotion update path is understood and stable enough to refactor
software_sequence.done_criteria: Locomotion couples reusable path and time-law functions instead of hardcoding both inline
software_sequence.validation: Code review plus focused simulation check of the refactored gait path

software_sequence.title: Integrate full gait generation in simulation
software_sequence.objective: Produce stable per-leg targets and phase behavior across the whole robot in Webots
software_sequence.entry_criteria: Reusable locomotion, IK, and nominal posture pieces are available
software_sequence.done_criteria: A chosen world demonstrates stable commanded stepping behavior in simulation
software_sequence.validation: World-specific simulation evidence for nominal stance and motion

software_sequence.title: Connect operator input and motion states
software_sequence.objective: Let the console or joystick trigger posture transitions and teleop motion in a controlled state machine
software_sequence.entry_criteria: Input wrapper and gait controller entry points are available
software_sequence.done_criteria: Operator commands can raise to nominal and then drive movement through explicit states
software_sequence.validation: Input integration test confirms correct state transitions

software_sequence.title: Prepare hardware-facing bring-up
software_sequence.objective: Align the software stack with calibration, interface, and safety expectations needed for real hardware
software_sequence.entry_criteria: Simulation posture and motion control are stable enough to inform hardware integration
software_sequence.done_criteria: Bring-up sequence, interface assumptions, and validation gates are explicit
software_sequence.validation: Bring-up checklist and validation matrix are complete and reviewed

manual_streams.prompt_1: What is the next physical design decision that blocks software or integration?
manual_streams.prompt_2: What evidence proves this mechanical step is done?
manual_streams.prompt_3: Which repo or external artifact should this row point to?

manual_streams.name: Electronics
manual_streams.focus: Power, motor interfaces, buses, wiring, controller boards, protections
manual_streams.prompt_1: What interface or power constraint is currently limiting integration?
manual_streams.prompt_2: What bench test or schematic evidence closes this item?
manual_streams.prompt_3: Which document, diagram, or note should this row reference?

manual_streams.name: Manufacturing and Procurement
manual_streams.focus: Bought parts, fabricated parts, assembly readiness, sourcing risk
manual_streams.prompt_1: Which part or fabrication step is next on the critical path?
manual_streams.prompt_2: What status tells you it is no longer a blocker?
manual_streams.prompt_3: What vendor, drawing, or BOM line should be linked here?

milestones.name: Architecture Baseline
milestones.focus: Project structure, workstreams, and technical anchors are defined
milestones.evidence: architecture.md updated and tracker sheets initialized

milestones.name: Single-Leg IK Validation
milestones.focus: FK and IK behavior are validated for a single leg in simulation
milestones.evidence: single-leg controller behaves repeatably and compile/lint checks pass

milestones.name: Raise to Nominal
milestones.focus: Robot can transition safely from motor zero to working posture
milestones.evidence: nominal pose command path and validation scenario are defined

milestones.name: Trajectory and Phase Library
milestones.focus: Path generation and time-law logic are separated and reusable
milestones.evidence: trajectory and time-law modules are coupled through locomotion

milestones.name: Simulation Gait Integration
milestones.focus: Gait generation produces stable leg targets in simulation
milestones.evidence: world-based validation exists for nominal stance and commanded motion

milestones.name: Teleop Controller Integration
milestones.focus: Operator commands can trigger posture changes and locomotion
milestones.evidence: controller state machine and input mappings are validated

milestones.name: Hardware Integration
milestones.focus: Mechanical, electronics, and control stack align on real hardware
milestones.evidence: bring-up, wiring, and standing behavior are verified

milestones.name: Full-Robot Walking
milestones.focus: Integrated walking behavior is demonstrated with evidence
milestones.evidence: simulation and hardware validation records exist for walking
